subject: Ellora onboarding: invite accept leads to preview/404 (mobile)
messages:
From: Ellora Onboarding <onboarding@ellora.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Ellora onboarding: invite accept leads to preview/404 (mobile)

Hi Marcus / Laura,

We got the supplier invite this morning but our vendor team can't complete the acceptance step from their phones.
When they tap the big "Accept" CTA in the email/webview it opens a preview of the W9 (PDF) and then shows a 404 page. On desktop the link works fine.

Attached is a screenshot from one of our users (iPhone 12, iOS 16.7, Gmail app) showing the Accept button and the preview overlay.

Can you advise if this is a known issue or a temporary workaround? We need to get a PO processed today so any quick unblock would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Raj Patel
Vendor Ops | Ellora Industries
onboarding@ellora.com

Attachment: ellora-screenshot-accept-404.png (image/png)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@ellora.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Coupa Support <support@coupa.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ellora onboarding: invite accept leads to preview/404 (mobile)

Hi Raj — thanks for the report and the screenshot, that helps.

Quick triage notes:
- We can't reproduce the 404 on desktop.
- Screenshot suggests the PDF preview overlay is intercepting the tap target in the mobile webview (Gmail mobile/Gmail app). If the link is an inline anchor that the PDF viewer is prioritizing, the accept action may never reach our accept handler.

Ben — adding you for SSO / front-end routing context. Can you check whether the invite URL is rendering a PDF inline on certain user agents and whether we have a safe fallback param?

Raj — can you confirm the full invite URL (you can paste the path only) and the browser/user agent from one of the affected devices? Also, try opening the invite using the device's browser (Safari/Chrome) instead of the Gmail in-app preview as a temporary test.

I've opened Jira INB-4127 to track this and added the screenshot. Attaching a short checklist of steps we usually ask for: troubleshoot_steps.txt

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Platform Support — Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachment: troubleshoot_steps.txt (text/plain)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@ellora.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Coupa Support <support@coupa.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ellora onboarding: invite accept leads to preview/404 (mobile)

I've reproduced this in Safari on iOS (Gmail app webview) — the invite link opens, but the PDF viewer takes focus and the accept anchor is effectively behind the viewer. Quick notes and proposed temporary mitigation: 

1) Workaround (quick, low-risk): append the param ?forceAccept=1 to the invite URL. That forces the server to render a small accept page instead of inlining the PDF and will bypass the viewer behavior.
2) Root fix (frontend): change the invite response to set Content-Disposition: attachment for PDF assets when the request comes from typical mobile webviews, or render the accept action before streaming the PDF. Frontend engineering estimates a two-day fix, followed by a canary rollout.
3) Monitoring: we'll add a short-lived regression check to catch similar regressions (mobile webview accept failures) and a metric in INB-4127.

Example of the quick workaround you can try immediately (Raj):
- Original invite: https://invite.redwood.com/i/abc123
- Workaround: https://invite.redwood.com/i/abc123?forceAccept=1

Marcus — I'll open a PR for the header/content-disposition change and coordinate with the runtime team for the canary.

Ben Carter
Senior SRE — Platform
Redwood Inference
